title: Repair all Artifact contract drift

tests.cmd: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/artifact-corpus.test.mjs (Ajv 2020 + TypeScript + Python over 108 fixtures and 3 sets)
npm run test:python (python -m unittest discover -s py), local
npm run build (bootstrap, assets, typecheck, vite build), local
npm run contracts:check (schemas + concept examples + corpus generator), local and CI
npx playwright test tests/browser/artifact-contract.spec.ts (local config, ports 21473/21797)
npm run test:browser (full Playwright suite incl. artifact-contract.spec.ts), CI

journeys: Real Python runtime run in the workbench; tampered artifact refused at the structure gate (/provenance/inputHash) and the semantic gate (/provenance/dependsOn/0); previous valid result kept as stale; untampered run accepted (screenshot inspected).

Actual Contoso ExportService (contoso-data-studio f2d0c75, 7 Gold marts) and actual FOIL exported artifacts (datapass-factory-foil adcb9e6, 4 files): accepted by the new schema, TypeScript and Python; rejected by the baseline schema.
browser: Playwright-managed Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0) locally; CI browser recorded in qa/browser-version.txt of the CI artifact
omissions: Byte budget: Python counts a lone surrogate as 3 UTF-8 bytes where JSON.stringify writes a 6-byte escape; no fixture sits on the 1 MiB boundary.
Integers beyond 2^53 parse exactly in Python but lose precision in JavaScript; not covered by the corpus.
FOIL exporter not re-run; its committed exporter outputs at adcb9e6 were validated.
Existing browser specs that hard-code port 4173 were run only in CI, not locally (local ports must be above 20000).
ci_run is the run for source_sha 01f4e15; the follow-up commit adding this receipt, the QA note and the spec origin fix has its own CI run on PR #46.
Python unittest discover errored once locally (1 of 20, under 100 % CPU from other sessions, test not captured); two later local runs and CI passed 20/20.
